name: Magical Analysis
summary: From Booty Bay, Baron Revilgaz sends you north to Dalaran with water elemental bracers. He hopes Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can study the curse tied to the Stone of the Tides.

sections.title: A Plea to Dalaran
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz sends you north from Booty Bay with water elemental bracers. The town has no mage skilled enough to unravel the curse behind the Stone of the Tides, so he points you toward Dalaran. Its wizards are working to rebuild their broken kingdom. Revilgaz has dealt with Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver before and trusts his knowledge. He believes no mage can resist an intriguing puzzle.

sections.title: The Archmage's Lore
sections.body: In Dalaran, Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver pauses his work when you tell him about the relic. Years ago, he wrote a scholarly treatise on the ancient legends of the Gurubashi Empire. That study gives him rare insight into the relic’s past. He examines the bracers and finds trace magical residue to study. Setting aside his work, he turns to uncovering the enchantment’s nature.

faq.q: Who sends you to Dalaran for this study?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay gives you a bag of elemental bracers and sends you to consult Dalaran’s wizards.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz pick Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver?
faq.answer: Revilgaz has dealt with Ansirem Runeweaver before and trusts the archmage’s vast knowledge. He believes mages cannot resist a magical puzzle.

faq.q: What came before this journey to Dalaran?
faq.answer: Before traveling to Dalaran, you gathered water elemental bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Water Elementals.

faq.q: What comes next after reaching the archmage?
faq.answer: Giving the bracers to Ansirem leads to Ansirem’s Key.

angles.text: As a mage, you carry arcane artifacts to an archmage of the Kirin Tor. Baron Revilgaz believes mages cannot resist a magical puzzle.
